summary.text: Dan Bronoske is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 28-Position 2 since January 11, 2021, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a firefighter and a veteran of the Washington Army National Guard.

paragraphs.text: Bronoske lives in Lakewood, Washington, and served with the Washington Army National Guard for six years.
His career experience includes working as a firefighter.

During the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Health Care and Wellness, Innovation, Community & Economic Development, & Veterans, Labor and Workplace Standards, and House Transportation committees, and chaired the Joint Veterans' and Military Affairs Committee.
